content.short: IPOR builds Fusion, vault infrastructure for accessing, deploying and managing onchain strategies.
content.description: IPOR started as an on-chain interest rate benchmark and now builds Fusion, infrastructure that lets managers run vaults which allocate across protocols from a single interface. It is one of the few protocols deployed on all three of Hyperliquid, Monad and Robinhood Chain. The vault-infrastructure framing has become the common way for managers to bring strategies on-chain without writing protocol code.
